name: Disable ad & telemetry daemons
description: 1.2.0 adds five services a running-state audit found active and unmasked while the trio above were already masked: screen-analysis-service-manager (parent of the contents-* family, TLS-capable), app-context-manager and acm-watcher, com.samsung.tv.waapp-contents-provider, and emergency-log-transmitter, which also gets its own vendor switch at /tmp/eltlaunch.cond. reporterCA is left alone deliberately (DRM reporting under /opt/usr/apps/Ddrm, no network stack). 1.1.0 added the other two members of the contents-analysis stack (ui-detector, cognition manager) and the .path/.socket activation triggers, so the daemons no longer have a watcher re-arming them. Masks and stops Samsung's ad/telemetry daemons (adagent/pisa, canalysis, slive, contents recognition, context-aware, cis) at every boot.
author: levkropp
